## Docker Images

### `pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}` (default — driver 580+, CUDA 13.0, PyTorch 2.7.0)

```
docker pull pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}
```

### Fallback variants (older NVIDIA drivers)

- `docker pull pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}-cuda12.8-pytorch2.7.0` (driver 570+)
- `docker pull pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}-cuda12.4-pytorch2.6.0` (driver 550+, e.g. RTX 3090/4090/A4000)
- `docker pull pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}-cuda12.1-pytorch2.6.0` (driver 535+)
- `docker pull pedront/comfyui-anime-bootstrap:v{{version}}-cuda13.0-pytorch2.7.0` (driver 580+)
